name: caret
description: Interactive visuals in chat: understand what your AI built, how a system works, or what your numbers say.

interface.longDescription: Caret turns answers into visuals you can explore, right in the conversation. Ask what an agent just built, how a system or process works, why a plan ranks things the way it does, or what a set of numbers says, and Caret draws it: flows, architectures, timelines, charts and comparisons you can click through. Visuals are private to your account; you can export an image or GIF, or share a hosted link.
capabilities: Draws interactive diagrams of systems, flows and processes in the chat
Charts numbers you paste or ask about: funnels, trends, comparisons
Explains what an AI agent or coding assistant built, step by step
Exports a visual as a PNG or looping GIF
Shares a visual as a hosted link, optionally password protected
defaultPrompt: Claude Code says the referral program is done. Walk me through what happens when someone invites a friend.
What happens to our app if us-east-1 goes down?
Where do our signups come from, and where do they go?
